basic_info.description: Welcome to Axis, a modern boutique building situated at the crossroads of Nob Hill, Lower Polk, and Downtown. This stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers the perfect mix of city convenience and contemporary comfort. Step inside to find a bright, open floor plan with hardwood floors, oversized windows, and great natural light. The living area is both inviting and unique highlighted by a custom mural that adds bold artistic flair. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, sleek cabinetry, and stone countertops ideal for cooking or entertaining. The spacious bedroom provides a quiet retreat with ample closet space, and the bathroom is updated with modern finishes. In-unit laundry and secure building entry offer added ease and privacy. One of the standout features of this home is access to the shared rooftop deck, offering panoramic views of the San Francisco skyline perfect for morning coffee, evening sunsets, or weekend hangouts.    With a Walk Score of 99, you're steps from dining, nightlife, coffee shops, Trader Joe's, and public transit. This is city living at its best whether you're a first-time buyer, urban professional, or investor. Don't miss the opportunity to own a slice of San Francisco in one of its most connected neighborhoods.
